overview_description.description:
Newera.ai enables enterprises to leverage agentic and generative AI by transforming complex business challenges into deployed, production-ready solutions. Operating across Saudi Arabia and the MENA region, Newera.ai specializes in building AI systems tailored to specific organizational needs.
Unlike traditional AI consulting firms that focus on strategy and recommendations, the company takes an execution-first approach, building, deploying, and scaling AI solutions that solve real operational problems. Our work spans compliance automation, HR digitization, workflow intelligence, and custom agentic AI systems.
